map.提示：核素胃排空扫描是评估胃动力的金标准。检测前需停用影响胃动力药物（促动力药停: Note: Radionuclide gastric emptying scan is the gold standard for assessing gastric motility. Before testing, drugs affecting gastric motility must be stopped (prokinetics 3 days, opioids 48 hours, anticholinergics 48 hours). Blood glucose control matters (>278 mg/dL can delay emptying). The wireless motility capsule (WMC) can simultaneously assess whole-GI transit time. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：胃排空（核素法）测定与胃轻瘫判断: 📚 Deep Dive: Gastric Emptying (Radionuclide Method) Measurement and Gastroparesis Judgment
map.消化不良查因：由核素胃排空扫描残留率算 T½ 与排空率: Finding the cause of dyspepsia: compute T½ and emptying rate from radionuclide gastric emptying scan retention rates
map.胃轻瘫诊断：4h 残留率 >10% 或 T½ >90min 提示延迟: Gastroparesis diagnosis: 4h retention >10% or T½ >90 min indicates delay
map.倾倒综合征：2h 残留 <30% 或 T½ <30min 提示排空过快: Dumping syndrome: 2h retention <30% or T½ <30 min indicates too-rapid emptying
map.算法：2h 排空率 = 初始残留 − 2h 残留；4h 同理。2h 残留 >60: Algorithm: 2h emptying rate = initial retention − 2h retention; the same for 4h. 2h retention >60% delayed, 30%~60% normal, <30% on the fast side; 4h retention >10% delayed, ≤10% normal; half-emptying T½ >90 min prolonged, 30~90 min normal, <30 min shortened. Combined: 4h retention >10% or T½ >90 min → delayed gastric emptying (gastroparesis); 2h retention <30% or T½ <30 min → possible dumping syndrome; otherwise normal.
map.例：初始 100%、2h 残留 65%、4h 残留 30%、T½ 90min →: Example: initial 100%, 2h retention 65%, 4h retention 30%, T½ 90 min → 2h emptying 35%, 4h emptying 70%, 4h retention 30%>10% judged delayed gastric emptying (gastroparesis); screening for mechanical obstruction, optimizing glucose, and prokinetics are advised. If 2h retention 40%, 4h retention 5%, T½ 60 min → 4h retention ≤10% and T½ normal, judged normal gastric emptying.
map.核素胃排空是金标准吗？: Is radionuclide gastric emptying the gold standard?
map.核素闪烁扫描是目前胃轻瘫诊断的首选生理学检查（4h 残留 >10% 为延迟），但: Radionuclide scintigraphy is currently the first-choice physiological test for gastroparesis diagnosis (4h retention >10% indicates delay), but it is affected by test meal type (solid/liquid), equipment, and operation. The ¹³C-octanoic acid breath test can serve as a non-invasive alternative, while electrogastrography and ultrasound have limited reference value.
map.T½ 和 4h 残留哪个更关键？: Which matters more, T½ or 4h retention?
map.两者互补：4h 残留率直接反映延迟程度，T½ 反映排空速度。临床常用 4h 残留: The two complement each other: the 4h retention rate directly reflects the degree of delay, while T½ reflects the emptying speed. Clinically 4h retention >10% is used as the main gastroparesis criterion; prolonged T½ (>90 min) supports the diagnosis, while shortened T½ (<30 min) suggests dumping syndrome.
